$comment: Task C4's pixel-diff thresholds (src/visual/diff.mjs), read via loadThresholds(). Both are the brief's suggested starting values, KEPT because the 2026-07-10 calibration evidence showed a wide margin between same-pair and cross-variant fixtures at these exact numbers (~4x separation on the closest cross-variant pair, tonal vs elevated). Full calibration table, fixture dimensions, and the C8 re-verification caveat now live in profiles/m3-kit/README.md (the canonical record) — see also src/visual/diff.mjs's module docstring for a short summary and src/visual/diff.test.mjs for the executable version of the decisive rows. IMPORTANT: every calibration row is a proxy (code-vs-code or Figma-vs-Figma), NOT a genuine code-vs-Figma same-state pair — these values are provisional until Task C8 re-verifies maxDiffRatio against a real matched pair (see README.md). Recalibrate here (not by hand-editing diff.mjs) if a future profile's real components need a different tolerance. maxDiffRatioText is the relaxed tier for text-bearing components (badge, filter-chip, snackbar, etc.) where cross-renderer font antialiasing benignly pushes diffRatio to 0.05-0.09 even when renders are visually identical — measured 2026-07-14 (filter-chip 0.058, badge 0.055). Both tiers are exposed via diff.mjs's PIXEL_EXACT / TEXT_TIER named constants and thresholdFor(entry, thresholds). scaleInvariantTags: cemTags whose Figma variants embed different whitespace padding per shape (e.g. circle 640px content in a 760px frame, clover 592px) so pure-scale differences across variants are expected and should be collapsed via the scaleInvariant path in diffPngPair. textTierTags: cemTags that render real text via harness-injected slot content but have no kind:text prop (so isTextBearing misses them); these receive TEXT_TIER even without a kind:text prop. benignAaTags: non-text cemTags whose only cross-renderer delta is benign antialiasing on curved shapes + icon-FONT glyphs (e.g. m3e-fab — a filled rounded FAB whose Material Symbols glyph antialiases differently between Chromium and Figma, ~0.09 with no structural mismatch, human-approved 2026-07-18); same 0.10 tier as textTierTags, just not literal text.
